g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure IoT factory telemetry with IoT Hub, Stream Analytics, Data Explorer and Digital Twins

g.title: None.None.Node.24
g.text: The IoT Edge gateway reads machine values from the PLCs' OPC UA server
On first boot it gets its identity and hub from the Device Provisioning Service
It batches readings and sends them to IoT Hub over MQTT with TLS
A message route archives every reading to Blob Storage
and a data connection streams them into Azure Data Explorer
Plant engineers see line trends in Managed Grafana
Stream Analytics reads the hub's built-in endpoint and runs anomaly detection on each machine
and writes anomalies to an Event Hub
The alerting function raises a maintenance alert through an action group
A second function keeps each machine's state current in Azure Digital Twins
